description: This file contains assembly code for controlling the SRAM clocks and DRAM settings on a Realtek RTL839X chip. It includes functions to set the DRAM clock rate, disable branch prediction, and configure clock source switching, specifically tailored for the RTL839X hardware platform.

methods.name: rtcl_839x_dram_start
methods.description: Label marking the start of DRAM initialization code.

methods.name: rtcl_839x_dram_set_rate
methods.description: Function to set the DRAM clock rate, which alters PLL and clock source settings based on input parameters.

methods.name: rtcl_839x_dram_size
methods.description: Variable that holds the size of the DRAM, defined as an assembler word.
